The '''Glottal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glottal]].
